items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Max Roach was really fond of uh, of Mingus... he would go see him all the time.

ctx.x: Yeah, and he had uh, sometimes quintets, sometimes sextet, and uh, uh, Max Roach was really fond of uh, of Mingus, especially, you know, he would go see him all the time. And he and Abbey Lincoln who, uh, recently married at that time, came and uh, um, Mingus was having one of his tantrums. In fact, he had his bass by the neck and he was draggin' it through some, uh, goin' toward the stage through some swinging doors. You know, it was just … practically mutilated his bass.
